claim: Ordering is not available on Custom Event Bus - Classic, the bus type that uses rules and targets; on the Custom Event Bus, ordering is FIFO delivery within an event group, per subscriber.

evidence.quote: | Ordering | FIFO delivery within an event group, per subscriber. | Not available. |
evidence.table_header: | Capability | Custom Event Bus | Custom Event Bus - Classic |

evidence.quote: In the EventBridge console, the bus type is shown as Custom Event Bus for this bus and Custom Event Bus - Classic for the buses that use rules and targets.
